Based on BackPack by Amin Mohammadi (AminMGMT)
https://github.com/AminMGMT/BackPack

Unmodified upstream engine: v1.8.5
Source commit: ff86354bcafbd054e7888e48343145323c9b2207
Source archive: BackPack-v1.8.5-source.tar.gz (complete tracked source at tag)
Binary origin: https://github.com/AminMGMT/BackPack/releases/tag/v1.8.5
Included official release binaries: linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
Checksums checked against upstream SHA256SUMS and pinned in GRETUN.sh.
The engine is executed only in L3 engine mode with ports = [].
Original license, NOTICE, trademark terms and all source/build files accompany it.
The GRE-TUN Bash adapter is separate from the unmodified upstream engine.
For rebuilding, extract the source archive and see its Makefile, go.mod and docs/releasing.md.
